{{Top}}
The '''Imperial calendar''' was a [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standardized]] dating system used in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> Contrary to the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar]] that was a 12-month/368-day calendar,<ref name="MCBY">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref> the Imperial calendar was a 10-month/368-day calendar. The Imperial calendar rigorously respected the formal definition of the [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|standard]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]], namely 10 [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]] of 35 days + 3 festival weeks + 3 holidays.<ref name="LotE" /> Despite the diffusion of the Imperial calendar in the [[Imperial Space]],<ref name="LotE" /><ref name="HSatCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> the Great ReSynchronization calendar remained the most used calendar during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="GN">''[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]''</ref>

In the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], the Imperial calendar was only used when dealing with the outside [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] while the local [[Tapani calendar]] was used for domestic affair. Nevertheless, the Tapani calendar was slightly adjusted to match the Imperial calendar.<ref name="LotE" />
